# Payment Status Card

Matches the success card in `post/success.tsx`.

## Preview

<PaymentStatusCardDemo />

## Installation

<Installation name="payment-status-card" />

## Usage

```tsx
import { PaymentStatusCard } from '@/components/lomi-ui/payment-status-card';

<PaymentStatusCard
  organizationName="Keur Studio"
  organizationLogoUrl="/merchant-logo.webp"
  primaryAction={{ label: 'Continue', href: '/orders' }}
/>;
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| `organizationName` | `string` | Merchant name for the avatar fallback. |
| `organizationLogoUrl` | `string \| null` | Optional merchant logo URL. |
| `title` | `string` | Success heading. Defaults to `Payment successful`. |
| `description` | `string` | Supporting copy under the heading. |
| `primaryAction` | `{ label: string; href?: string; onClick?: () => void }` | Continue button. |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | Optional slot for downloads or license keys. |
